planets.name: TOI-6223 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6223 with a 3.86-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-6223 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6223. Its orbit and size follow Yalçinkaya et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
